data: Is the value of the red square at iterative step 3 higher than the value of the red star at the same step?

The red square represents the Ja-En ELBO score, while the red star represents the En-De BLEU score. The question asks whether the value of the red square at iterative step 3 is higher than the value of the red star at the same step. From the figure, we can see that the red square (Ja-En ELBO) is consistently above the red star (En-De BLEU) across all steps, including step 3. Therefore, the value of the red square at iterative step 3 is indeed higher than the value of the red star at the same step.
